executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Sheraton Guadalajara Expo's primary issue is entering AI consideration at all, especially for Adventure & Experiences.

What the Data Is Telling Us. AI Consideration is 11.9%, so the hotel appears in only a limited share of individual comparable responses. When the hotel is absent, JW Marriott Hotel Guadalajara is a leading observed alternative in those gaps — an evidence lead for review, not an automatic proof of recurring substitution. Rank tactics have limited value until relevance improves. The primary constraint is becoming part of the answer set for the traveler needs the hotel currently misses. Softest Scenario Capture is Adventure at 0.0%. JW Marriott Hotel Guadalajara most often appears when the hotel is missing (24 scenarios).

Why It Matters. Fine-tuning rank against individual competitors will have limited value until the hotel becomes relevant in more of the traveler needs it currently misses. Entry problems and rank problems require different management attention. If leadership optimizes competitor comparisons first, the hotel can look busy while still missing the larger answer-set gap.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Adventure is the softest Scenario Capture at 0.0%, while Business Travel show broader coverage. Focus where the gap is concentrated rather than treating every territory equally. JW Marriott Hotel Guadalajara appears most often when the hotel is missing (24 scenarios) — use that pattern for source and fact checks, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 32.0% (8 of 25 attributes). Start with gaps that matter operationally — beginning with Family-Friendly.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on how the hotel is represented for Adventure & Experiences. Review whether the attributes, positioning, and use cases most relevant to those travelers are complete and consistently represented across priority sources. Treat competitor-rank tactics as secondary until entry improves.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change.

What to Review Next. Compare evidence from scenarios where JW Marriott Hotel Guadalajara appears with the property information currently available for Sheraton Guadalajara Expo. Check entry cues first — product type, occasion, and location framing — before broadening the review to secondary attributes.

positiveSignal.title: Positive Signal
positiveSignal.body: Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Sheraton Guadalajara Expo appeared in the Top 3 72.7% of the time. This shows how prominently the hotel is positioned when AI includes it.

secondaryCallout.title: Watch Item
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 47.6% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 11.9% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.

managementPriority.title: Management Priority
managementPriority.body: Focus first on how the hotel is represented for Adventure & Experiences. Review whether the attributes, positioning, and use cases most relevant to those travelers are complete and consistently represented across priority sources. Treat competitor-rank tactics as secondary until entry improves.

Correct only the sources where facts are missing, conflicting, or outdated. Do not change measurement methodology. Store completion evidence (canonical policy summary, sources reviewed, sources corrected, URLs/screenshots, completion date). Notify Dealality of completion so the next monitoring period can check the expected signal without assuming causation.
